'''2010 Match Play Championship Day 1 Barry Alperstein DS Imperial Occupation (V)''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Barry Alperstein]] at [[2010 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Imperial Occupation (V) / Imperial Control (V)|VB2-D-imperialoccupation-pre.gif}}
* '''Username:''' Mr From Mars
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
